name: Badge
description: A compact status badge in six variants (default, secondary, outline, success, warning, destructive) that springs in on mount, with an optional pulsing status dot and a remove button that animates the badge out.
a11yNotes: Renders an inline span whose text is the accessible content; the status dot is aria-hidden decoration. The optional remove control is a native button labelled 'Remove <label>' with a visible focus ring. Under prefers-reduced-motion the pop-in, exit scale and dot pulse are disabled.

propsApi.name: label
propsApi.description: Badge text (ignored when children are provided).

propsApi.name: shape
propsApi.description: Fully rounded pill or a 6px rounded rectangle.

propsApi.name: pulse
propsApi.description: Animate the dot with a radiating pulse.

propsApi.name: removable
propsApi.description: Show a remove button; the badge animates out when pressed.

propsApi.name: onRemove
propsApi.description: Called after the remove button is pressed.

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Fill of the default variant and dot color of secondary/outline.

propsApi.name: animateIn
propsApi.description: Pop in with a small spring on mount.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
